resources.string: Screenus Deletus watches which app is in the foreground so it can enforce the screen time limits you set. It only reads the package name of the foreground app. No data leaves your device.
Prevents Screenus Deletus from being uninstalled on impulse. Deactivating it is logged and triggers lockdown mode.

Deactivating Screenus Deletus is a tamper event. Your rules will switch to lockdown and your guardian (if set) will be told. Use Screenus Deletus\'s \"Pause protection\" if you want to turn it off without a penalty.
